specificOwnerQuestions: ACK exact eec/A63 Windows build baseline or deliver the current selected bounded rebase/source cut; publication of source is not acceptance.
Publish actual29-product entrypoint/package inventory: identify real EXE versus library/embedded surface and approved shared-host launch route; retain missing products.

Deliver current Home bootstrap/package/installed identity/service-version tuple, trusted runtime and donor sidecars used by those products. Native Home current deny-all/unavailable routes and legacy shell are not substitutes.
Select desktop x64 and confirm college laptop actual architecture/support; no ARM compatibility claim from this win-x64 probe.
Supply genuine scoped Windows app acceptance/install/launch callers and independently review final exact package bytes, Home handshake, account/provider/security/GUI/donor/cross-app criteria.
Identify authorized clean Windows machine/VM for no-repository/no-SDK and interactive acceptance, plus authorized delivery destination or immutable downloadable artifact route.

runnerRoute.automaticTrigger: Push reviewed proposal branch team-c/sol-happy-c1-windows-build-proposal-20261004; no defaultbranch/main changes needed. Root alone pushes/starts.
runnerRoute.permissions: contents:read; checkout persist-credentials:false; no source patches, commits, main pushes or signing/trust activation.
runnerRoute.dispatchTool: No new workflow_dispatch or runner-management tool found in exposed GitHub tools; existing read-job/artifact tools can observe run.
runnerRoute.probeScope: Release win-x64 full publish directory ZIP; exact extraction/hash readback and bounded actual EXE/window/close observation in disposable runner. Normal source analyzers/warnings unchanged.
runnerRoute.acceptanceQualification: Hosted runner has SDK installed; no-SDK clean-install, original full suites, interaction/accessibility and complete29 packages still require actual owner acceptance.
